title: API Database Incident
description: The API at http://127.0.0.1:18085/health returns 500. Logs suggest a configuration problem.
mission: Investigate the log and configuration, repair the database URL, then confirm a healthy response from /health.
success: The configuration is repaired and the API health check succeeds.

lesson.what_happened: The health failure was downstream of an invalid database endpoint in configuration.
other_solutions: Trace the error from HTTP to logs to configuration
lesson.be_careful: Do not expose real database credentials while debugging.

files.content:
INFO api starting on :18085
ERROR database connection failed host=old-db.internal
WARN health endpoint will return 500

hints: Start with the HTTP response and logs/api.log.
Compare service.conf with the provided example.
After fixing the URL, request /health again.
